justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype IDs wrap u64, AccountType is a proper enum, and LedgerError variants carry typed payloads, though nothing further distinguishes domain concepts like signed amounts or account names.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with three meaningfully distinct variants carrying contextual data, no panics or unwraps, and proper Display/Debug implementations.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean public surface with appropriate derives, Display on the error, and a Default impl, but no doc comments on any public item.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses iterators, sum, map, pattern matching, and Default idiomatically, but redundantly tracks balance per account while also storing entries, and could use entry/get_mut chaining more tightly.
